content: Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is until 11:00. Late check-out can be arranged for a fee, if the room is free.
No. 1, Section 4, Zhongshan North Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei City (台北市中山區中山北路四段1號).
02-2886-8888. Our reservations desk answers the phone every day from 08:00 to 22:00.
We take cash, credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, JCB) and mobile payment.
Hotel guests park free in the hotel car park, one car per room. Visitors pay NT$60 per hour.
The breakfast buffet is served every day from 06:30 to 10:00 in the main restaurant on the 1st floor.
The outdoor swimming pool is open every day from 07:00 to 21:00. It is free for hotel guests.
The fitness room is on B1. It is open every day from 06:00 to 22:00 and is free for hotel guests.
Pets are not allowed in guest rooms. Guide dogs are welcome.
The nearest MRT station is Yuanshan (圓山站). A free hotel shuttle runs between the station and the hotel. Taoyuan Airport is about 50 minutes away by car.
Free cancellation up to 3 days before arrival. After that, the first night is charged.
Children under 6 stay free when they use the existing beds. Extra beds are listed in the price list.
Free Wi-Fi in all guest rooms and public areas.
A 10% service charge is added to room, dining and service prices. The prices in our price list do not include it.
